scientific_limitations: Explicit construction on the real two-sphere, with a Hermitian complex kernel and real part. No minimality statement across all kernels; neither associated RKHS is C-universal. Exact infinite-dimensional assertions rely on the analytic proof; finite numerical experiments are auxiliary. Earlier broad 2020 nonradial sphere paper was accessible by abstract only.
title: Two spherical harmonic modes per degree suffice for strict positive definiteness
